title: A new species of the genus Dysommina from the Lakshadweep Sea, India (Anguilliformes: Synaphobranchidae: Ilyophinae)
content:
Abstract

This study describes a new Dysommina species, based on two specimens collected at a depth of ca. 600 m in the Lakshadweep Sea off south-western India. The new species differs from its congeners in having fewer total vertebrae (120–127 vs. 134 in D. castanea, 133–134 in D. brevis, and 137–141 in D. orientalis), fewer predorsal vertebrae (14–15 vs. 16 in D. pygmaea), fewer preanal vertebrae (24–27 vs. 28–31 in D. rugosa), and in a combination of morphometric, meristic, dentition and colouration characters. DNA sequences were generated and analysed.
author: Paramasivam Kodeeswaran
